verdict.rationale: TypeSafe publishes a Python SDK changelog page (docs/sdk/python/changelog.md) with entries like adding AI-gateway examples. The models page and `GET /v1/models` expose versioned model IDs (e.g. jev-1.13.0) with release dates and an alias policy. That covers SDK changes and gives some model-version visibility, but there is no evidence of a dedicated, maintained changelog for model releases or API changes. Missing for 10: a documented model/API release-notes page, a JavaScript SDK changelog, evidence of maintenance cadence, and independent corroboration that the changelog is kept current.

support.subject: As a developer, model and API changes land in a maintained changelog or release notes I can follow

citations.quote: add examples for usage with AI gateways
with a description and release date for each
pin that version's ID instead of the alias and move to the new one on your own schedule.
